blocks.text: A reboot of Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan’s 1998 romantic comedy “You’ve Got Mail” is in development at Warner Bros. Pictures. Deadline reported on Tuesday, Nov. 10, that filmmaker Jason Orley is tapped to direct the new version. Orley is also working on the screenplay, based on an earlier draft by writers Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont. Plot details, including whether the new film will follow the original story or introduce a different take on its premise, remain under wraps.
